sections.title: Player win rates
sections.tldr: GRCX leads at 63.3%, ragnarneves trails at 36.7%, on 30 games. One standard error is about 9 points.

sections.title: Duo win rates
sections.tldr: Best pairing: GRCX + RikiPlancha12 at 85.7% (6-1). Worst: BabyGolem + ragnarneves at 14.3% (1-6). Every duo has few games, so none of this is settled.

sections.title: Champion win rates
sections.tldr: 83 distinct champions in 120 player-games. Best with >= 2 games: Dr. Mundo 100.0% (3-0), Sylas 100.0% (3-0), Tristana 100.0% (3-0).

sections.title: Tilt tracker
sections.tldr: After a loss: 44.0% (50 games). After a win: 56.0% (50 games). Losses are followed by more losses, but within sampling noise.

sections.title: Session fatigue
sections.tldr: 5 sessions, longest 10 games. Late-session samples are small and biased. Biggest drop from games 1-3 to 4+: BabyGolem (53.3% to 40.0%).

sections.title: Time of day
sections.tldr: 19 of 30 games began between 00:00 and 05:59.

sections.title: Game length buckets
sections.tldr: Short: 2 games, mid: 25, long: 3. Best in short games: GRCX (100.0%). Best in long games: GRCX (66.7%).

sections.title: Stomp vs throw
sections.tldr: Average game 16:14; shortest 10:18 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem), longest 22:31 (won by GRCX + RikiPlancha12). Widest loss-vs-win length gap: BabyGolem (+101 s).

sections.title: Multikills
sections.tldr: GRCX leads with 24 multikills. Group: 64 doubles, 0 triples, 0 quadras, 0 pentas.

sections.title: First blood
sections.tldr: Teams with first blood won 56.7% (17-13); without it 43.3% (13-17). Most first-blood kills: GRCX (14).

sections.title: Combat profile
sections.tldr: Highest kill pace: GRCX (0.45/min). Highest death pace: BabyGolem (0.42/min), lowest: ragnarneves (0.37/min). Lowest damage per kill (kill-steal index): BabyGolem (4,452).

sections.title: Team share
sections.tldr: GRCX takes the largest damage share (55.8%); BabyGolem is the biggest punching bag (37,795 damage taken per game).

sections.title: Champion pool
sections.tldr: Widest pool: RikiPlancha12 (29 champions in 30 games). Narrowest: BabyGolem (favourite Rek'Sai x4).

sections.title: Liability index
sections.tldr: Highest deaths per minute: Kalista (0.51), then Neeko (0.50), Vayne (0.49). Min 2 games.

sections.title: Records
sections.tldr: Single-game extremes across all four players (ties go to the earliest game).

sections.title: Worst defeats
sections.tldr: Most deaths in a loss: BabyGolem on Shen, 11 deaths (61.1% of the team's deaths).

sections.title: Clean execution
sections.tldr: 0 deathless wins across 120 player-games.

sections.title: Time dead
sections.tldr: BabyGolem spends the most estimated time dead (20.8% of playtime). Dead time is estimated; alive time is exact.

sections.title: Augments
sections.tldr: 161 distinct augments picked. Best with >= 3 games: Pressure Cooker 100.0% (4-0), Dual Wield 100.0% (3-0), Transmute: Gold 100.0% (3-0). Worst: Bread and Cheese 0.0% (0-6), Totentanz 0.0% (0-4), Snowday 0.0% (0-3).
